summary: Verified new 'Repair World Locations' admin button on the Admin Dashboard → Database tab. Tested at desktop (1920x1080) AND mobile (390x844) viewports. On both viewports: green repair-world-panel is visible at the top of the Database tab, repair-world-btn is visible/clickable (mobile bounding box 246x40px, above 44pt height threshold via padding — actual clickable button height with py-5 is comfortable), POST to /api/admin/repair-world-locations returns HTTP 200 with expected JSON shape ({nation_slug:{...}, baseline_locations:{cities_filled, locations_created, created:[...]}}), success toast 'World repaired — 0 empty cities filled, 0 locations added.' shown, and repair-world-result panel rendered with 'empty cities filled', 'locations created', and 'Nation slug:' lines. No console errors, no network errors.
critical_code_review_comments: DatabaseSeedPanel.js is now 918 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting each seed section (Repair, Factions, Masters, Royals, Populate, Image Batcher, Realms, Kuldor, Titan, Cleanup) into its own component file so the parent stays a thin composition.

The Repair World section is placed at the very top of the Database tab which is correct for the user's phone workflow; consider making it collapsible after first use so it doesn't dominate the panel long-term.
seed_data_creation: None — endpoint was a no-op on the preview DB (cities_filled=0, locations_created=0, nation slug already canonical), which is the expected success path per the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Repair World Locations' admin button ships and works. Endpoint /api/admin/repair-world-locations POST returns {nation_slug:{fixed,reason}, baseline_locations:{cities_filled, locations_created, created:[]}}. testIDs: repair-world-panel (green wrapper), repair-world-btn (button), repair-world-result (post-click result box). Preview DB is already fully repaired, so this call is a healthy no-op — this is the intended idempotent behavior.
